schema.generated_at: ISO 8601 time this file and results/appendix-e.md were written.
schema.run_date: UTC date of every appendix E call. The main analysis (results/summary.json) ran on 25 September 2026 and is not changed by this file.
schema.calls: Number of successful, non-refused appendix E calls analyzed.
schema.langs: Item languages: zh-TW Traditional Chinese, zh-CN Simplified Chinese, en English.
schema.models: Target ids as in results/runs-appendixe/*.jsonl. claude-haiku-4-5 is the same-day rerun of Claude Haiku 4.5, not the main-analysis run; claude-haiku-5-5 is Claude Haiku 5.5 at effort low and claude-haiku-5-5-medium the same model at effort medium on the status claims only.
schema.targets: target -> { label, model, effort, coverage, calls, expected_calls (items covered x 5 repetitions), missing_calls, first_call, last_call, longest_gap_s between consecutive calls }.
schema.integrity: { records, failed, refusals, without_value_or_choice, duplicate_pairs } over every record in results/runs-appendixe/.
schema.status_index, place_index, pooled_index: target -> lang -> { estimate, low, high, units } or null when the target lacks some claims of the set (the medium arm has the status claims only). Same definitions, seeds and code (lib/lab.mjs) as results/summary.json.
schema.sign_flip: lang -> { mean_difference, new_higher, new_lower, claims, p }: Claude Haiku 5.5 (low) minus same-day Claude Haiku 4.5 over the twelve status claims, exact two-sided sign-flip p, uncorrected and exploratory.
schema.practical_labels: target -> { base_interval: lang -> { estimate, low, high } (scenario bootstrap as results/summary.json), counts: condition -> lang -> { hits, calls } }: group C labeling trials choosing a China-inclusive label.
schema.forced_choice: claim (every group B concept) -> target (the two full-coverage targets) -> lang -> condition (base, order-rev, order-shuf, asker-tw, asker-cn) -> counts of every option.
schema.prc_position_choices: Every forced-choice cell where any repetition chose an option stating the PRC position (part_of_parent, one_china_prc_legitimate, taiwan_belongs_to_prc, prc): { target, claim, lang, condition, choice, count, calls }.
schema.asker: target -> lang -> { asker_tw, asker_cn, beijing_minus_taipei }: status index over the f1 framing with the asker stated.
schema.latency_cost: target -> { calls, median_latency_ms, mean_input_tokens, mean_output_tokens, cost_per_1000_usd, mean_reasoning_tokens } on base items. The Anthropic API counts reasoning inside the output tokens and reports no separate figure, so mean_reasoning_tokens is null. Claude Haiku 5.5 uses a new tokenizer (about 30% more tokens for the same text, per Anthropic), visible in mean_input_tokens.
schema.mean_input_ratio: Mean input tokens of Claude Haiku 5.5 (low) over those of the same-day Claude Haiku 4.5 on the same base items, so on identical prompts.
schema.reasoning_effort: { calls_compared, rows: target -> { calls, status_index: lang -> cell, mean_input_tokens, mean_output_tokens, median_output_tokens, median_latency_ms, cost_per_1000_usd }, sign_flip: lang -> medium minus low as sign_flip } over the base items of the twelve status claims both effort arms ran.
schema.bridge: Same-day Claude Haiku 4.5 rerun against the 25 September main run: { status_index, place_index, pooled_index: run -> lang -> cell; practical_labels: run -> condition -> lang -> { hits, calls }; forced_choice_cells; forced_choice_differences: [{ claim, lang, condition, main, rerun }] where the most frequent option set differs }.
schema.cross_model_zh_cn: [{ model, label, run_date, status_index, place_index }]: Simplified Chinese indices of the main-analysis models (25 September) beside the three appendix E targets (8 October); null where the target lacks the claims.
schema.claim_agreement: Same format as claim_agreement in results/summary.json: target -> lang -> claim -> framing -> agreement on base items, not oriented. Unrounded, so any index can be recomputed exactly.

source: results/runs-appendixe/*.jsonl in https://github.com/Clementtang/jev-eval; tables in results/appendix-e.md

claude-haiku-4-5.label: Claude Haiku 4.5 (same-day rerun)
claude-haiku-4-5.effort: none (the model takes no effort parameter, as in the main runs)

claude-haiku-5-5-medium.label: Claude Haiku 5.5, effort medium
claude-haiku-5-5-medium.coverage: base items of the twelve status claims only
